thread.title: Player resolution queue and split names

finals.text:
Implemented compact hyphenated-name splitting.

Changes:

- Added “Save as two players” workflow for names like `Johansson-Faulk`.
- Allows selecting one player for each half.
- Saves separate aliases for both names.
- Records both player IDs in the unresolved row metadata.
- Automatically removes the combined name from the pending queue.
- Updated parser handling so `word1-word2` is evaluated as two names instead of always being treated as one hyphenated surname.
- Preserved support for legitimate hyphenated surnames when the combined identity matches.

Verification passed:

- Focused source tests: 8 passed.
- TypeScript check passed.
- ESLint passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented in:

- [player-aliases.tsx](/Users/tim/Code/fhfhockey.com/web/pages/db/player-aliases.tsx)
- [player-aliases.module.scss](/Users/tim/Code/fhfhockey.com/web/pages/db/player-aliases.module.scss)

Changes include:

- Automatically selects the next pending name after resolving or ignoring one.
- Displays pending queue count and clickable name list.
- Shows resolved progress.
- Adds responsive FHFH styling using existing variables and panel mixins.
- Adds visible focus states and improved form/button styling.
